# Acceptance fixture: Pinhole sunglasses

> **Invent yourself: Pinhole sunglasses**  
> Investigate the optimal arrangement of pinholes in an opaque film to produce sunglasses that reduce light intensity and help correct short-sightedness.

## Structural expectations

- Preserve both prompt objectives: intensity attenuation and myopia correction.
- Include an essence statement and linked optical-correction and throughput branches.
- Consider a Fourier-optics whole-chain candidate and a simpler geometric/diffraction limiting model.
- Treat pure geometric optics as incomplete unless diffraction is addressed.
- Keep comfort, ghosting, and field of view optional rather than prompt-mandated objectives.
- Permit a Pareto-front outcome without arbitrary scalar weights.
- Name and explain every filtered candidate.

This fixture tests reasoning structure only. It is not a literature source and does not fix the final scientific conclusion.
